name: drawgen
description: Generate, check and export draw.io diagrams as editable .drawio.svg files, alone or inside markdown documents.
long_description: Claude writes a short spec (components, zones, labelled edges); drawgen builds the draw.io diagram, checks it for overlaps, broken edges and labels that will not fit, and writes NAME.drawio.svg: an SVG GitHub shows as a picture, with the diagram embedded so draw.io, its VS Code extension and GuardStein open it for editing. Exact rendering and previews need draw.io Desktop, which the install_drawio tool can fetch (about 170 MB, it asks first); without it a built-in renderer is used.

workdir.title: Diagrams folder
workdir.description: Where relative paths such as docs/flow.drawio.svg are written.
